correctness.rationale: Coordinate truth table equals the binary polynomial local update. Disjoint 101 swaps, stable 00 pairs and bounded leftward travel give exact recurrent-set decomposition and at-most-N freezing. The four-state de Bruijn matrix for forbidden 101 has trace recurrence; the two-state Fibonacci matrix counts words avoiding 00. These directly imply exact Fix(F_N^t), Möbius cycle counts and the finite-map zeta Euler product, including N=1 and N=2. Independent truth-table and polynomial implementations passed 24,676 exhaustive finite diagnostics (N<=12); the infinite-domain proof is the swap/transfer argument, not the experiment.

value.rationale: The theorem resolves the natural complete finite-ring periodic-orbit counting problem, not a small-n census: it identifies every recurrent configuration and all temporal primitive cycles for arbitrary N; it supplies explicit Möbius counts and a rational dynamical zeta function together with a global N-step basin-entry bound and asymptotic separation of frozen and traveling recurrent states. These exact invariants permit direct comparisons of irreversible blocking-rule recurrence with recently studied reversible higher-order cellular automata. No general downstream theorem is claimed.
